traits.note: Abrams's flora (vol. 1, 1923; ferns by Maxon): rhizome erect or ascending; fronds up to 2 m, erect and arching, on short stipes; blades lanceolate, narrowed at both ends, two or three times pinnate, their segments toothed to cut again (so typically three); sori under 1 mm, oblong to crescent- or horseshoe-shaped.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a delicate, deciduous fern: a vase of soft, lacy, twice-divided fronds widest in the middle. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 1 m tall at 4 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: light yellow-green fronds.

traits.rhizome_habit.note: The spec's value is from its `traits` note (abrams-1923). Hoshizaki and Moran, Fern Grower's Manual (2001) p. 207-210: rhizome short-creeping to erect, clump-forming. The spec stated {"erect": "usually", "ascending": "often"}. Combined on the owner's rule (2026-10-15): where two sources differ, both are kept and the range spans them.
